verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a single marketing line on the Rev AI homepage saying the product can be deployed 'in the cloud or on-prem' (rev-ai-docs-19). That is a first-party claim of self-hosting, but the rest of the documentation describes only the hosted cloud API. Missing for 10: on-prem deployment documentation (installation, container images, hardware requirements), which features and models are available on-prem, licensing or access terms for self-hosting, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
